title: Sammy Davis Jr. as entertainer
summary: Royal considers him the best all-around entertainer.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well, he -- working with Sammy was always a gas, because in my estimation, he is head and shoulders above all performance, so far as actually performing and doing his thing. I think he can follow anybody in this world as a performer and still do his thing and a lot of people that are supposed to be great performers wouldn't dare go on behind him.

He is head and shoulders above practically anybody as an all-around, worthy entertainer. He knows what's going on with it. I don't agree with a lot of fine entertainers, when they start getting political and going into other things, which a lot of them do, because I think entertainers are sup-
posed to be entertainers and do their thing, but as long as he stays into his category as an entertainer, he is positively the best there is in my estimation.
Very, very good musical taste. He's a natural. He can do the thing.
And he usually surrounds himself with (inaudible).
He usually surrounds himself with good people, not always the best, but good. Of course, you can't always get the best. But he does a pretty good job of surrounding himself with worthy people.
